description_en: Creates a scheduled stream pulling configuration, which includes parameters such as the origin URL, start time, and end time
description_zh: 添加拉流配置信息，包括源站地址、开始时间和结束时间
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-pull-stream-info-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --source-url rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000_rtmp://developer.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLivePullStreamInfoConfig

parameters.help_en: The streaming domain where the ingested stream will be hosted and distributed from
parameters.help_zh: 您的拉流域名为用户的主播流域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The custom name of the application
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所属应用名称，用户自定义
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The custom name of the live stream
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The origin URL of the live stream. You can specify multiple URLs. Separate them with semicolons (;).

You can pull only live streams in the RTMP, FLV, HLS, and SRT formats
parameters.help_zh:
用户的直播流所在的源站完整url。多个源站可以填多个地址，用英文分号（;）分隔。
仅支持拉取直播流，支持RTMP、FLV、HLS、SRT格式
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.help_en: The time when stream pulling starts. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 拉流开始时间。 StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The time when stream pulling ends.

The time range specified by the StartTime and EndTime parameters cannot exceed seven days. The time must be later than the current time. Specify the value in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 拉流结束时间。 StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内，且EndTime超过当前时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time
